name: Kono Hoshi Saigo no Ren'ai o.
source: Five dragons have appeared in this world. Without any way to defeat them, human civilization is gradually being destroyed. The people prayed for a hero, so the Financier of Chaos appeared before the last princess with the ability to slay dragons... Takaku Tatsuma. Humanity made two miscalculations -- the "princess" was a 16 year old male, and the hero... their chosen hero... had already gone completely mad.
translation:
五条巨龙出现在这个世界。人类文明逐渐被摧毁，却没有任何办法打败它们。人们祈求英雄，于是混沌的金融家出现在最后一位公主面前；她拥有斩杀巨龙的能力……高久龙马。
人类犯了两个误判——“公主”是16岁的男性，而英雄……他们选中的英雄……早已彻底疯了。
